theorem lg_target {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) : ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x := by
  intro x hx
  let n := ⌊x⌋₊
  have h1 : n ≤ x := floor_le
  have h2 : n ≥ 1 := le_of_lt (lt_trans (lt_one_of_gt hx) (le_rfl))
  have h3 : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x ≥ 0 :=
    add_nonneg (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_refl (Real.log 4)) (le_refl x))
                (le_refl (√x)))
  let h4 : Real.log √x > 0 :=
    lt_trans (lt_zero_of_neg (Real.log_pos (sqrt_pos (le_refl x))))
             (le_refl (Real.log √x))
  let h5 : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x = Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x :=
    rfl
